status: Preliminary supplier evidence and explicit allowances for a reproducible cost computation. Not a Chief selection, procurement approval, budget-compliance verification or physical acceptance.

budget.scope: All purchased vehicle hardware and materials, excluding tax and shipping; every item is purchased and no owned item is credited (human inputs 4bddc18afd6e47edac3c2dc062165571 and 73e1aafadc23440ba2c6091eec049e83).
budget.purchase_unit_policy: ASSUMPTION requiring human confirmation: the full price of the smallest purchasable unit counts (1 kg filament spool, 1 m tube, multi-battery pack); partially used stock is not apportioned.
budget.gse_policy: ASSUMPTION requiring human confirmation: items listed in excluded_gse are ground support equipment outside the vehicle total.
budget.spares_policy: Spares are excluded unless the smallest purchase unit forces them.

currency_conversion.source: Reserve Bank of Australia, Exchange Rates - Daily, table Units of Foreign Currencies per Australian Dollar, United States dollar row
currency_conversion.policy: Convert every USD price with the minimum listed USD-per-AUD value, giving the largest AUD amount.
limitations: Values come from text extraction of the RBA page; the time-of-day basis of the USD row was not independently confirmed.
Card, bank or marketplace FX margins are excluded except in the sensitivity case.
Prices accessed on 2026-10-01 use the same conservative rate.

cases.conservative: Use a retailer-printed tax-exclusive price when present; otherwise conservative_unit_price when present, else unit_price, without deduction; USD converted per currency_conversion.policy.
cases.tax_exclusive_estimate: Use a retailer-printed tax-exclusive price when present; otherwise unit_price, divided by 1.10 only for price_basis au_displayed_gst_status_unstated or au_displayed_incl_gst; no deduction for overseas prices.
cases.conservative_fx_margin: Conservative case with USD-derived AUD amounts multiplied by 1 + fx_margin_sensitivity_fraction.

price_basis_codes.overseas_list: Overseas USD list price treated as tax-exclusive.
price_basis_codes.overseas_taxes_included_unknown: Overseas price shown with Taxes included and no breakdown; never deducted.
